en-US.name: Knots Partner
en-US.summary: A thinking partner that turns what you are curious about into things to watch, read and explore.
en-US.description: Tell Knots what you have been thinking about and it suggests a film, series, documentary, video or paper that makes the idea concrete, with a reason for each. Say good pick or not for me and it learns what fits you.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask knots partner what should I explore
Alexa, ask knots partner about memecoins

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say: open knots partner. Then: about memecoins. Then: good pick. Picks come from TMDB, YouTube and arXiv.
